clips.title: The story
paras: Frostmane trolls hold Shimmer Ridge in northern Dun Morogh, west of the Gates of Ironforge. Its two camps span a chasm, and the ridge is the only place shimmerweed grows.

Frostmane trolls hold the high ground west of Ironforge's gates. Two camps sit on opposite sides of a chasm, joined by a wooden bridge. Troll scavengers and their tamed mountain boars guard the camps. The ridge lies near the main road and the dwarven capital, so travelers and mountain patrols face raids from above.

Frostmane trolls grow shimmerweed on the ridge. Dwarven brewmasters prize the plant for potent, flavorful highland ales, and it cannot easily be gathered elsewhere. Mountaineers and young recruits brave troll ambushes and tusked beasts to gather it from the trolls' plots.
